title: Answer: consciousness plays no fundamental role

statements.text: Despite its name, algorithmic idealism gives consciousness, belief and agency no fundamental role. Only a small subset of self states describe agents, and a smaller subset conscious agents. The view complements, and does not contradict, the view that the material world causes experience.

sources.quote: higher-level concepts such as consciousness or belief do not play any fundamental role
why it would complement but not contradict the view that the material world is the cause of our experience
